The site looked different because the "Acme Sans" web font stopped loading, so every page fell back to a default font.

The `@font-face` rule in `site/css/tokens.css:5` pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2`. The file actually lives in `site/fonts/`, so the request returned a 404. I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`.

I re-ran the visual tests after the fix. All 12 snapshots (6 pages at desktop and phone size) now match the approved baselines. I didn't touch the baselines, and nothing needs approving. I didn't run the functional tests, since the change only affects the font path.

The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't check which change introduced the wrong path.
